text.en: Gaia personifies the Earth as a source of life and the center of the story. JFC uses her journey to ask how people can protect the natural balance.
text.zh-TW: Gaia 是生命泉源大地的化身，也是故事核心。JFC 透過她的旅程，思考人類如何維護自然平衡。

text.en: The Dewi Bumi stage prologue centered on Gaia. detikJatim also reported a Raja Ampat marine motif in Gaia’s street presentation. A separately credited Raja Ampat design appeared in Artwear, and the shared motif does not establish a costume link.
text.zh-TW: 舞臺序幕《Dewi Bumi》以 Gaia 為核心。detikJatim 也報導 Gaia 的街頭演出運用 Raja Ampat 海洋意象。Artwear 另有一件具名的 Raja Ampat 設計；相同意象不足以證明為同一套服裝。

text.en: Gaia anchors the whole story.
text.zh-TW: Gaia 貫穿全篇。

openQuestions.en: A defile-specific cast and costume-design credit list has not been verified. Do not link event participants or artwork to a named costume without evidence.
openQuestions.zh-TW: 尚未核實本分隊完整演出與服裝設計名單；缺乏證據時，不應把活動來賓或展圖連到具名服裝。

text.en: JFC connects Noise to misinformation and social disorder. Distorted accounts and public conflict can drown out a person’s sense of identity.
text.zh-TW: JFC 以 Noise 描繪錯假資訊與社會失序；扭曲的說法與衝突可能淹沒個人對身分的理解。

text.en: Post-event reporting describes traditional Indonesian mask imagery in the festival presentation.
text.zh-TW: 會後報導提到，嘉年華演出採用了印尼群島的傳統面具意象。

text.en: Noise is a human and social disruption within the world Gaia is trying to heal.
text.zh-TW: Noise 描寫 Gaia 試圖修復的世界中的人為與社會失序。

text.en: JFC uses health crises to show how vulnerable people and societies are when everyday life is disrupted.
text.zh-TW: JFC 透過公共衛生危機，呈現日常生活受擾時個人與社會的脆弱。

text.en: The festival card establishes the crisis theme. A verified material list for a particular costume is unavailable.
text.zh-TW: 嘉年華說明卡可確認危機題材；尚無針對特定服裝的可靠材料清單。

text.en: Pandemic shows the vulnerability of life within Gaia’s larger story of distress and recovery.
text.zh-TW: Pandemic 在 Gaia 面對創傷並尋求復原的故事中，展現生命脆弱的一面。

openQuestions.en: A defile-specific cast and costume-design credit list has not been verified. Do not link event participants or artwork to a named costume without evidence.
openQuestions.zh-TW: 尚未核實本分隊完整演出與服裝設計名單；缺乏證據時，不應把活動來賓或展圖連到具名服裝。

text.en: JFC presents a place to pause and reflect. Earth offers room for healing and balance, and the defile invites care for living beings.
text.zh-TW: JFC 將它呈現為停下與反思的空間。大地提供修復與恢復平衡的可能，也邀請人們關照各種生命。

text.en: Post-event coverage describes Sanctuary closing the street sequence as a refuge for Earth and living beings.
text.zh-TW: 會後報導記載 Sanctuary 為街頭隊列收尾，將它描寫成大地與生命的庇護所。

text.en: Sanctuary is the refuge and reflective pause within Gaia’s healing journey.
text.zh-TW: Sanctuary 是 Gaia 修復旅程中的庇護與反思時刻。

text.en: The organizer evokes a guardian of a frozen world and links warming to threats to long-established ways of life. Protection comes with facing the consequences of human action.
text.zh-TW: 主辦方以冰封世界的守護者為意象，將暖化與長久生活方式所受的威脅相連；守護也意味著面對人類行為的後果。

text.en: The icy setting is supported by the official concept card. Specific fabric and construction credits are unresolved.
text.zh-TW: 冰封背景有官方概念卡支持；確切面料與製作人員仍待查證。

text.en: The guardian represents protection within the threatened world Gaia embodies.
text.zh-TW: 守護者代表對 Gaia 所化身、正受威脅的世界的守護。

openQuestions.en: A defile-specific cast and costume-design credit list has not been verified. Do not link event participants or artwork to a named costume without evidence.
openQuestions.zh-TW: 尚未核實本分隊完整演出與服裝設計名單；缺乏證據時，不應把活動來賓或展圖連到具名服裝。

text.en: JFC’s card examines what happens when power and greed erode empathy. The defile puts humanity’s moral choices under scrutiny.
text.zh-TW: JFC 的說明卡探討權力與貪欲侵蝕同理心的後果，藉此檢視人類的道德選擇。

text.en: Post-event reporting describes a gladiator figure as a metaphor for moral struggle and the defense of human values.
text.zh-TW: 會後報導提到，角鬥士形象用來象徵良知的掙扎與對人性價值的捍衛。

text.en: Conscience asks what humanity must confront in itself to participate in Gaia’s recovery.
text.zh-TW: Conscience 反問人類必須面對自身哪些問題，才能參與 Gaia 的修復。

openQuestions.zh-TW: 尚未核實本分隊完整演出與服裝設計名單；缺乏證據時，不應把活動來賓或展圖連到具名服裝。

text.en: JFC emphasizes repairing what was damaged and finding strength through cooperation. Re-Birth carries the possibility of recovery after crisis.
text.zh-TW: JFC 聚焦於修復破損之物，以及團結帶來的力量。Re-Birth 展現危機過後復原的可能。

text.en: A post-event account connects the defile with a Japanese philosophy of repair. The source does not establish a specific technique for the Unity artwork.
text.zh-TW: 一則會後報導把此分隊與日本的修復哲學相連；該資料無法證實 Unity 展圖使用了某一特定工藝。

text.en: Re-Birth expresses the possibility of renewal in Gaia’s arc from injury to healing.
text.zh-TW: Re-Birth 表達 Gaia 從創傷走向修復時重新開始的可能。

text.en: JFC links healing with respect for cultural inheritance. Remembering ancestral knowledge helps reconnect people with the world they depend on.
text.zh-TW: JFC 將修復與尊重文化傳承相連。記得祖輩知識，有助於人們重建與賴以維生的環境的關係。

text.en: Post-event coverage identifies Minangkabau cultural references. ANTARA reports maroon as a prominent costume color in this defile.
text.zh-TW: 會後報導辨識出 Minangkabau（米南加保）文化元素。ANTARA 記載此分隊服裝醒目的栗紅色調。

text.en: Roots relates Gaia’s recovery to cultural memory and a renewed relationship with nature.
text.zh-TW: Roots 將 Gaia 的復原連到文化記憶以及與自然重建的關係。
